LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 11.3.1 ADJECTIVES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Language Use 11.3.1 Adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 11.3.1 Adjectives, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we talk about people, things or places?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 11.3.1 Adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn- A learner’s self-discipline is enhanced as they are motivated to use adjectives to describe objects and people for effective

communication.

Values:
Unity: A learner shows team spirit during language games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills – (self-esteem) a learner's esteem is enhanced as they describe objects using adjectives correctly.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner applies knowledge about adjectives to talk about things in detail in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language activities.

Suggested learning resources

• Textbooks in print and in braille

• Audio recording

• Digital devices with assistive technology
